finalText:
**Drafted the 4.2.0 section** in [CHANGELOG.md:20](CHANGELOG.md#L20). Of 380 commits, 15 or so matter to users.

Three are breaking, and none were labeled that way. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. The v1 export route was dropped under a `refactor` commit. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from five modules, so imports break.

One real feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

Two things to check before you cut. Several commits note a minimum Node version and CI moved to Node 22, so confirm the floor in `package.json`. And `fix(db): stop logging the whole request body` may be worth a security note.
